subject.title: [Feature]: Make managed browser launch degrade cleanly when no display server is available

question: Should browser-control errors add an additive closed `reason` and typed `details` contract for explicit headed/no-display managed launches, and what exact envelope should clients preserve?
rationale: The remaining gap is a public agent/tool error contract, and repository policy treats fallback/config/error surfaces as compatibility-sensitive; automation should not choose the permanent envelope shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add reason/details envelope
options.body: Preserve the existing `error` string and add a closed `reason: "no_display_for_headed_profile"` plus typed details through `BrowserProfileUnavailableError`, route serialization, client errors, tests, and docs.

options.title: Keep string-only errors
options.body: Close the contract gap intentionally by documenting that agents must treat this as a human-readable launch failure, leaving current route/client behavior unchanged.

options.title: Allow broader headless fallback
options.body: Permit explicit headed profiles to fall back to headless under a new policy/config path, accepting the compatibility risk of overriding visible-browser intent.

recommendation.title: Add reason/details envelope
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing `error` string and add a closed `reason: "no_display_for_headed_profile"` plus typed details through `BrowserProfileUnavailableError`, route serialization, client errors, tests, and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent browser error/fallback code path in current main and is assigned to the issue.
